group.name: Feedback-Driven Agent Adaptation
group.definition: 장기 과제를 수행하는 에이전트를 대상으로, 실행 중 발생하는 실패·성공 궤적과 환경 피드백을 재사용하지 못하거나 상태와 능력이 누적되지 않는 문제를 지속적인 학습·실행 갱신 루프로 해결하는 기술이다. 구체적으로 실행 trace와 rollout을 분석해 메모리, 스킬 문서, 실행 하니스, 정책 또는 모델 가중치를 갱신하고, 영속 상태·체크포인트·검증 게이트를 이용해 변경 결과를 다음 작업에 반영한다. 입력의 leaf_007이 생성 영상과 콘텐츠 제작 자체를 자동화하는 기술군인 것과 달리, 이 그룹은 에이전트의 장기 행동과 학습·실행 메커니즘을 개선하는 데 초점을 둔다.
group.evidence_summary: 여러 구성원은 에이전트가 장기 실행에서 얻은 성공·실패 경험을 다음 행동과 시스템 구성에 반영하지 못하는 문제를 공통적으로 다룬다. 해결 방식은 실행 trace와 rollout을 분석해 스킬, 메모리, 반성 기록, 실행 하니스 또는 모델 정책을 갱신하는 것이다. 일부 접근은 가중치를 고정하고 텍스트 공간과 하니스만 최적화하며, 다른 접근은 LoRA·강화학습 등을 통해 정책 가중치까지 업데이트한다. 영속 상태, 체크포인트, 검증 게이트와 재계획은 이러한 개선을 실제 장기 과업에 유지시키는 공통 실행 기반이다.
group.why_emerging: 에이전트가 정적 벤치마크를 넘어 변화하는 도구와 과업을 장기간 수행하면서, 한 번 학습된 정책만으로는 새로운 실패와 작업 분포를 따라가기 어려워지고 있다. 동시에 장기 rollout, 다중 사용자 궤적, 지속 메모리와 실행 상태가 축적되면서 경험을 구조화해 재사용할 수 있는 입력이 늘고 있다. 그러나 업데이트가 성능을 높이는지, 오염·드리프트·보상 조작을 일으키는지 검증해야 하므로 피드백을 안전하게 학습과 실행 변경으로 연결하는 메커니즘의 필요성이 커진다. 자료에는 하니스 갱신, 스킬 편집, 정책 학습, 환경 공동진화가 함께 제시되므로 하나의 표준 방식으로 수렴했다고 보기는 어렵다.

evaluation.scenario: 카카오뱅크 AI가 검색·이체·상담·모임총무 등 여러 서비스를 장기 상태와 피드백을 바탕으로 지속 개선하도록 적용할 수 있다. 예를 들어 이체 확인, 상담 실패, 목표적금 코칭 결과를 실행 trace와 사용자 피드백으로 분석해 스킬·라우팅·복구 절차를 업데이트하고, 금융 안전성과 감사 가능성을 검증한 뒤 배포할 수 있다.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 AgenticOS Workshop

claims.name: Long-Horizon Agent Execution and Recovery
claims.evidence: How should long-horizon agentic systems be designed?

claims.name: Constrained Self-Evolving Agents
claims.evidence: How can constrained self-evolution preserve safety, reproducibility, and governance?

sources.title: Workshop on Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Agents (RL4LLM-Agents)

claims.name: Weight-Space Reinforcement Learning for LLM Agents
claims.evidence: Model-side RL updates the weights: RLHF, RLAIF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards.

claims.name: Harness-Side In-Context Reinforcement Learning
claims.evidence: Harness-side RL , increasingly known as in-context reinforcement learning , leaves the weights frozen and optimizes everything around them in text space.

sources.title: 2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning: Safety, Interpretability, and Agents

claims.name: Compositional Skill and Tool Planning Agents
claims.evidence: Key areas include the composition of skills and sub-goals for long-horizon planning, the systematic integration of retrieved knowledge and tools, and the creation of architectures that dynamically combine neural and symbolic modules to execute multi-step tasks.

sources.title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work

claims.name: Long-Horizon Task Decomposition, Delegation, and Replanning
claims.evidence: Agentic Coordination Scaling trains agents to decompose long-horizon tasks, delegate parallel work, integrate asynchronous results, and replan.

sources.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design

claims.name: Agent–Environment Co-Evolution
claims.evidence: Agent--Environment Co-Evolution extends this loop to adaptive tasks, feedback, and interaction spaces that change with the agents.

sources.title: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't

claims.name: Trajectory-Anchored Agent Skills
claims.evidence: Skills work when noisy trajectories become procedural anchors that stabilize execution.

sources.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning

claims.name: Black-Box Plug-in Environment Reshaping
claims.evidence: To automate this process, we introduce EnvRigger, which treats the target policy as a black box, observing its execution trajectories to synthesize EnvHarness components targeting diagnosed flaws, and validating them via fresh rollouts.

sources.title: First Workshop on Meta Agents: Managing Agents that Manage Agents

claims.name: Self-Improving Agent Evolution
claims.evidence: We welcome work on agents that rewrite their own code (the Darwin Gödel Machine, self-taught optimizers), self-play and co-evolution, open-endedness, and honest analyses of how self-improving agents drift or game their own reward.

sources.title: From Chatbot to Digital Colleague: The Paradigm Shift Toward Persistent Autonomous AI

claims.name: Persistent Workspace-and-Skill Agent Systems
claims.evidence: Second, at the tool-augmented task execution level, LLMs are progressing from tool-calling Agents that invoke external resources in an ad hoc manner toward OpenClaw-style workstation systems (OpenClaw) equipped with persistent Workspaces, skills, verification loops, and governance.

sources.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence

claims.name: Million-Token Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Persistent Rollout States
claims.evidence: At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations.

sources.title: Lifelong Agents: Learning, Aligning, Evolving

claims.name: Continual Learning for Lifelong Agents
claims.evidence: Such agents must integrate continual learning, long-term alignment with human values, and self-improvement under resource constraints to remain robust, trustworthy, and sustainable.

sources.title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild

claims.name: Continual Skill-Policy Meta-Learning for LLM Agents
claims.evidence: These mechanisms are mutually reinforcing: a refined policy generates better trajectories for skill synthesis, while richer skills provide higher-quality data for policy optimization.

sources.title: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement

claims.name: Contrastive Modular Harness Self-Improvement
claims.evidence: Experiments on TB2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified show consistent improvements on unseen in-domain and cross-domain tasks, with the evolved harness also transferring across different foundation models.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents

claims.name: Interaction-Feedback Loops for Self-Improving Agents
claims.evidence: It also connects to a fast-moving frontier of self-improving agents — agent recursive self-improvement, self-evolution, agent reinforcement learning, and the loop and harness engineering that lets agentic systems keep getting better through repeated interaction, feedback, and self-refinement.

sources.title: Second Workshop for REsearch on Agent Language Models (REALM)

claims.name: Long-Horizon Task Reliability for LLM Agents
claims.evidence: Beyond scaling, agents must become more reliable on long-horizon tasks, be evaluated in realistic settings, integrate planning, memory, and tools effectively, and interact safely with external environments.

sources.title: SKILL0: In-Context Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Skill Internalization

claims.name: Parameter Skill Internalization via Curriculum RL
claims.evidence: Yet inference-time skill augmentation is fundamentally limited: retrieval noise introduces irrelevant guidance, injected skill content imposes substantial token overhead, and the model never truly acquires the knowledge it merely follows.

sources.title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver

claims.name: Multi-User Trajectory-Based Skill Evolution
claims.evidence: SkillClaw continuously aggregates trajectories generated during use and processes them with an autonomous evolver, which identifies recurring behavioral patterns and translates them into updates to the skill set by refining existing skills or extending them with new capabilities.

sources.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills

claims.name: Feedback-Guided Text-Space Optimization for Agent Skills
claims.evidence: SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score.

sources.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling

claims.name: Durable-State Agent Execution Harnesses
claims.evidence: StateM turns selected postmortem findings into persistent, executable preconditions and practices, making learned controls explicit and enforceable through stateful controls.

sources.title: The 2nd Workshop on Lifelong Agent: Learning, Aligning, Evolving

claims.name: Memory-Managed Continual Learning Agents
claims.evidence: A lifelong agent should not only acquire new knowledge and skills, but also manage memory, personalize safely, interact with evolving tool ecosystems, and withstand long-term deployment without drift or brittle failures.

sources.title: Workshop on Failure Modes of Agentic AI at ICML 2026

claims.name: Trace-Level Diagnostics for Long-Horizon Agent Runs
claims.evidence: Diagnostics should look at the trace itself, not just the final score, because final-score evaluation hides almost everything interesting.
